name: Nostr Portable Home Status
description: Panel indicator for the portable home: sync state, loading progress, cache and home size, and conflicts you can resolve (through nostr-home-status / nostr-home-syncd). Reads $XDG_STATE_HOME/nostr-homed/porthome-status.json (falling back to ~/.local/state/nostr-homed/porthome-status.json). NEVER surfaces secret material.
